claims.value: Carbamidomethyl C fixed (UNIMOD:4); 13C2,D3-acetyl K fixed (MOD:01965); Oxidation M variable (UNIMOD:35); Acetyl Any N-term variable (UNIMOD:1); Gln->pyro-Glu N-term Q variable (UNIMOD:28)
claims.evidence: Mascot MODS=Acetyl:2H(3)C13(2) (K),Carbamidomethyl (C); IT_MODS=Oxidation (M) plus Gln->pyro-Glu (N-term Q) (F134281/F134361) or Acetyl (N-term) and Acetyl:2H(3)C13(2) (N-term) (F134282/F134362). FixedMod1 mass 47.036105 matches PSI-MOD MOD:01965 DiffMono 47.036106

Each RAW file holds exactly one biological sample. The 13C2D3-acetyl (AcDC) label is applied in vitro to every primary amine of that same sample to separate in vivo (light) from in vitro (heavy) N-terminal acetylation; it does not multiplex samples. PRIDE quantificationMethods 'MS1 based isotope labeling' refers to this intra-sample ratio

limitations: No PRIDE label term describes in-vitro heavy acetylation; comment[label] is 'label free sample' because no samples are multiplexed, and the heavy acetyl is recorded as a fixed K modification (MOD:01965).

The variable heavy acetylation of peptide N-termini (Mascot 'Acetyl:2H(3)C13(2) (N-term)', the heavy quantitation component) has no Unimod or verified PSI-MOD N-terminal term and is not in comment[modification parameters].
Age 40Y, sex male, organism part and sampling site bone marrow, and disease are Cellosaurus donor values for the parental HAP1/KBM-7 line, not measured in this study.
Mapping of KO1 to Cellosaurus CVCL_SZ97 rests on the matching 17 bp exon-2 deletion; the paper does not cite the Horizon catalogue number of the knockout clone.
Culture medium (IMDM + 10% FBS) has no NCIT term found in OLS, so characteristics[culture medium] is omitted. Passage number, cell type and ancestry category are not available.
Reduction and alkylation reagents are not stated in this record (protocol refers to PMID 28315243); carbamidomethylation of C was searched as fixed.
